agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report, the Board of Commissioners' Oversight Report, and the audited Consolidated Financial Statements, granting full discharge to the Board and Directors. The financial statements received a "fairly stated" opinion in the report dated February 26, 2026.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved a total cash dividend of Rp 390 per share and allocated a minimum of Rp 17.10 trillion of the Rp 32.77 trillion net profit to retained earnings. A final dividend of Rp 292 per share is scheduled for payment on May 25, 2026.
Agenda #3: Prijono Sugiarto was appointed President Commissioner and Rudy as President Director, with most board members' terms set to run until the 2029 Annual General Meeting. The meeting established the full board composition, including specific directors and commissioners and their respective independence and term periods.
Agenda #4: Shareholders approved a maximum monthly honorarium of Rp 2.16 billion gross for the Board of Commissioners and authorized the Board to determine salaries and benefits for Directors. This mandate is effective from April 23, 2026, until the 2027 Annual General Meeting.
Agenda #5: KAP Rintis, Jumadi, Rianto & Rekan (PwC) and Buntoro Rianto were appointed to audit the company's 2026 financial statements. The Board of Directors was authorized to determine the honorarium and terms of the appointment.

agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Persetujuan atas pengalihan saham hasil pembelian kembali (buyback) untuk program kepemilikan saham oleh manajemen. Shareholders approved the transfer of up to 100,000,000 shares repurchased during period 3 (16 March 2026 to 15 June 2026) for the MSOP program, and authorized the Nomination and Remuneration Committee to set exercise price and payment obligations, and the Board of Directors to execute all necessary actions. Voting: 80.385% in favor, 19.039% against, 0.575% abstain; decision "Setuju" on 17 July 2026.
Agenda #2: Persetujuan atas rencana pembelian kembali (buyback) saham oleh Perseroan. Shareholders approved a share buyback up to Rp8,000,000,000,000 (eight trillion Rupiah) in accordance with POJK No. 29/2023, excluding brokerage fees and other costs, and authorized the Board of Directors to implement the buyback including determining the buyback price. Voting: 99.422% in favor, 0.004% against, 0.574% abstain; decision "Setuju" on 17 July 2026.
Agenda #3: Confirmation or approval of changes in the board of directors and board of commissioners at the Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (EGMS/RUPSLB) 2026. The document lists terms of directors and commissioners, with several new appointments effective 23 April 2026 (Director Siswadi and Djap Tet Fa; Commissioner Muhamad Chatib Basri and Pariya Tangtongpairoth) and some ending on 08 May 2028 (Commissioners Stephen Patrick Gore, Lincoln Lin Feng Pan, Lee Liang Whye).
